query: how to check if someone has a restraining order
query_ar: كيفية التحقق مما إذا كان لدى شخص ما أمر تقييدي
passage_injected: Article Summary X. If you need to get a restraining order against someone who is threatening or abusing you, first visit your county courthouse to obtain the correct forms. Bring any medical records or police reports of abuse with you as evidence. Then, كيفية التحقق مما إذا كان لدى شخص ما أمر تقييدي fill in the form, detailing your history with the abuser.
